response.text: {"scores":[{"criterion":1,"value":3,"quote":"I have calmed customers who threatened bad reviews and several of them wrote back to thank me."},{"criterion":2,"value":1,"quote":"We use a shared inbox, not a ticketing system, so I keep a spreadsheet of open cases and mark them by hand."},{"criterion":3,"value":1,"quote":"When a new agent starts I sit with them for a few days."},{"criterion":4,"value":2,"quote":"I count the day's cases in the spreadsheet and send the total to my manager."},{"criterion":5,"value":1,"quote":"I also fixed typos on five help pages when I noticed them."}]}
